newsitem.title: USA: Nu-Tech gets 52.6 pct stake in Physicians.
newsitem.headline: Nu-Tech gets 52.6 pct stake in Physicians.

text.p: Nu-Tech Bio-Med Inc said Monday that a U.S. bankruptcy court in Calfironia had approved the Chapter 11 reorganization plan filed by Physicians Clinical Laboratory Inc.
As a result, Nu-Tech said, it will acquire a 52.6 percent interest in Physicians Clinical Laboratory.

Nu-Tech said the stake is consideration for $13.3 million of Physicians Clinical senior debt it held and the cancellation and satisfaction of a $5 million promisory note from Physicians Clinical in connection with Medical Science Institute, which Nu-Tech sold to Physicians.
Nu-Tech said the confirmed Physicians plan will be effective on or about April 28.
